timeline.event_summary: An intercepted call showed Malhotra reporting a collection figure to an unidentified, not-yet-matched contact.
An informant assessed a college-student punter placing small personal bets as unconnected to the syndicate.
An FIR was registered describing an illegal betting book run by Malhotra with proceeds moved through Ali's hawala route under an unnamed controller.
An intercepted call showed Malhotra and Ali confirming a settlement directly, with no controller involvement.
An intercepted call positively voice-matched the controller as Iqbal Ansari, who addressed both Malhotra and Ali within the same call.
A follow-up FIR recorded continued collection and settlement activity consistent with informant input.
An informant flagged an incidental wrong-number call and noted a modest expansion in Malhotra's collection network.
A follow-up FIR recorded the voice-verified identification of the controller as Iqbal Ansari, who remained unlocated.
A follow-up FIR recorded independent informant corroboration of the controller's identity as Iqbal Ansari.
An intercepted call showed Ansari addressing both Malhotra and Ali about a figure discrepancy within the same call.
An informant flagged an incidental call about an unrelated match result as unconnected to the investigation.
A field team directly observed Ansari meeting both Malhotra and Ali together at a shop back room for the first time.
An intercepted call showed Malhotra and Ali confirming a settlement directly, with no controller involvement.
An intercepted call showed Ansari addressing both Malhotra and Ali about the coming week's collection cycle.
An informant reported continued stable activity by Malhotra and Ali, with Ansari not seen in person recently.
Malhotra and Ali were apprehended in a coordinated action, leaving Ansari as the sole network figure still at large.
